stem: Joy can encode a batch of records in 5 hours, while Ana can do it in 20 hours. How long will it take them working together?
explanation: Rates add: 1/5 + 1/20 = 1/4 of the job per hour. Time = 1 ÷ 1/4 = 4 hours.

stem: An inlet pipe fills a tank in 40 hours. A drain empties the full tank in 48 hours. If both are open, how long will it take to fill the empty tank?
explanation: Net rate = 1/40 − 1/48 = 1/240 of the tank per hour. Time = 1 ÷ 1/240 = 240 hours.
